name: SearchJet – Instant Search
author: Maidul

sections.description:
SearchJet is a WordPress plugin backed by a secure cloud-based API that delivers lightning-fast, relevant results with minimal setup. Whether you run a blog, store, or enterprise site, it ensures instant performance and seamless integration.

  • Reindexing and indexing status updates
  • Document count tracking and usage reporting
  • Secure API key authentication for every request
  • Instant Ajax-powered search with analytics tracking
  • WooCommerce support included in Pro plan
  • Manage usage and indexing via the SearchJet.io dashboard
  • Try the live demo: https://demo.searchjetengine.com/

Our service is built on trusted open-source foundations for speed and reliability. Built on the open-source Meilisearch engine and designed to provide:

  • Instant, predictive search suggestions
  • AI-enhanced relevance
  • Detailed analytics dashboard (top queries, zero-result queries, daily volume)
  • Mobile-optimized, SEO-friendly search experience
  • Filters/synonyms/boosting (in paid plans)
  • Enterprise-grade performance across platforms

Privacy

SearchJet only collects the minimum necessary data to operate its search indexing and analytics services. We do not index or store sensitive or private data such as user passwords or admin content. Your data remains yours—secure, isolated, and encrypted in transit. For more details, please refer to your Meilisearch server’s privacy settings and documentation.

Demo & Learn More

Visit https://searchjetengine.com/ to explore features, pricing, docs, and platform integrations.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/searchjet directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > SearchJet and enter your Meilisearch Host URL and API key.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce support is available in the Pro version.

Does this plugin track search usage?

Yes, SearchJet tracks and reports search usage and analytics to help you monitor how your site search is performing. You can view this data through the SearchJet.io dashboard.
